Prevention: Application of enriched farm yard manure (1 tonne per acre).
Crop rotation with sorghum, bajara or cotton.
Early sowing i.e. 30 days prior to normal sowing dates.
Trim off trees and shrubs in and around the field to reduce suitable habitat for pest and therefore pest migration into the field.
Monitoring: Symptoms include pale, wilted plants dying in patches and stunted growth.
Installation of 1 light trap per acre to catch and help monitor adult beetles.
Place five pheromone (synthetic pheromone- Anisole) traps per acre to monitor for adults.
Consider direct control actions as soon as the pest is found, as the effective way to protect crops is prevention.
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Soil application of castor or neem cake (60 kg per acre).
Collection and destruction of white grub adults from host trees around the field e.g. neem and acacia.
